purpose: Define four independent specialist research desks under OCC, coordinated by the executive/OCC layer and constrained by the central risk policy.

rules: Unknown provenance, unknown licence, unapproved source, stale data, invalid instrument mapping, crossed or non-finite prices, missing bid/ask, or clock uncertainty blocks signal qualification.
Delayed, indicative, historical, and synthetic data are research-only and cannot satisfy live readiness.
A source failover is not independent unless separately verified for ownership, upstream dependency, timestamp and licence.
Never silently substitute a symbol, venue, contract, currency, multiplier or timezone.
Every output must preserve source references and the exact input snapshot/version.
No output is an order, instruction to trade, target size, leverage setting or execution permission.
No numeric confidence may be presented as a calibrated probability unless calibration evidence exists.
Missing evidence or a failed gate yields no_assessment or halt, never a guessed signal.
A desk may raise a stop challenge but cannot clear another desk's stop or override central risk controls.

desks.name: Crypto Specialist Desk
specialist_checks: bridge, oracle, custody and smart-contract incidents
hard_stops: venue status or order state uncertain

desks.name: Forex Specialist Desk
specialist_checks: broker symbol suffix and contract size
central-bank releases and scheduled macro risk

desks.name: Equity Indices Specialist Desk
coverage: index CFDs for instrument-risk research only
specialist_checks: constituent concentration and macro event risk

desks.name: Gold Specialist Desk
specialist_checks: XAUUSD versus futures versus CFD distinction
real yields, USD, central-bank demand and event risk
physical, allocated, unallocated and derivative exposure distinctions
explicit quote basis separating broker XAUUSD, indicative bullion spot, COMEX futures, CFDs and synthetic fixtures
quote age versus configured stale threshold and explicit stale flag
financing status and settlement type recorded as known or explicitly unknown
spot/futures basis only from time-aligned, provenance-linked legs
hard_stops: ambiguous XAUUSD or futures contract mapping
stale or indicative-only quote presented as tradable
unknown financing, swap or settlement terms
quote age exceeds stale threshold or stale flag is true
gold quote basis or session/calendar provenance missing
spot/futures basis calculated from unaligned or unprovenanced legs
desks.dedicated_requirement: Gold remains a first-class specialist desk with its own data lineage, contract mapping, research, risk flags, paper evaluation and readiness evidence. It must not be folded into generic forex coverage.

cross_desk_coordination.handover: outgoing desk records last accepted snapshot, open hypotheses, stale dependencies, unresolved incidents and next review time; incoming desk acknowledges before ownership transfer

review_items: interest, swap, rollover and financing charges
halal_and_financial_review.rule: Do not label an instrument, strategy or account halal based only on its asset name or a model-generated opinion.

readiness_gates: Named accountable owner and independent reviewer
Deterministic instrument and contract mapping tests
Clock, freshness, spread, session and missing-data tests
Paper evaluation with fees, spread, slippage and rollover where relevant
Position, order, fill and restart reconciliation
Cross-desk conflict, outage and handover rehearsal
Risk and halal review where applicable
Explicit owner approval before any live capability is even considered

capital_flow_handoff.source_of_truth: OCC canonical capital-flow event record plus verified append-only review ledger
rules: Resolve every event ID against the canonical event and verified review ledger at consumption time.
Preserve source reliability, attribution confidence, event confidence and materiality as separate dimensions.
Do not convert a capital-flow observation into a trade stance, order, sizing, leverage or execution permission.
The Crypto desk independently validates token/contract identity, event finality, attribution, liquidity and relevance.
